title: How to run async jobs one at a time, in order
problem: My writes need to happen one at a time and in order, and the array-plus-busy-flag queue I wrote breaks the moment a second caller starts it, a rejected job leaves the flag stuck, or a retry queues the same work twice.
outcome: A queue that runs jobs strictly in arrival order, accepts more work while it is draining without starting a second pump, keeps going when a job throws, and answers what is still waiting and what can still be cancelled.

knowledge: Work in your app that must not overlap or reorder: an outbox, an upload queue, or saves against one record
